SELECT count(*) AS june_complaints FROM payments.customer_complaints
WHERE complaint_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND complaint_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT 'daily_sales' src, count(DISTINCT sku) skus FROM store.daily_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines', count(DISTINCT sku_scanned) FROM store.pos_lines
UNION ALL SELECT 'pos_lines_gtin', count(DISTINCT gtin_scanned) FROM store.pos_lines

SELECT sum(ds.revenue_inr) AS revenue,
       sum(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) AS cogs,
       sum(ds.revenue_inr) - sum(ds.units_sold * p.cost_inr) AS gross_margin
FROM store.daily_sales ds
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = ds.sku
WHERE ds.date >= '2026-06-01' AND ds.date < '2026-07-01';

SELECT (SELECT sum(amount_inr) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01') pos_pay_jun,
       (SELECT sum(line_amount) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') pos_lines_jun,
       (SELECT sum(revenue_inr) FROM store.daily_sales WHERE date >= '2026-06-01' AND date < '2026-07-01') daily_jun,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM payments.pos_payments WHERE ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01') n_pay,
       (SELECT count(DISTINCT bill_id) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') n_bills;

       round(sum(ds.revenue_inr),0) revenue,

SELECT f.sku,
       sum(GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - ds.units_sold, 0))::int est_lost_units,
       round(sum(GREATEST(f.forecast_units_per_day - ds.units_sold, 0) * p.price_inr),0) est_lost_revenue
FROM store.forecasts f
JOIN store.daily_sales ds ON ds.sku=f.sku AND ds.date=f.date
JOIN store.products p ON p.sku=f.sku
WHERE f.date >= '2026-06-01' AND f.date < '2026-07-01'
GROUP BY f.sku ORDER BY est_lost_revenue DESC;

batches.final:
All questions explored; here are the final answers.

**Q1 — Range add/drop.** All 11 SKUs sold on all 28 days and all carry positive margin. The standout issue is availability, not range: ATTA-WW-5KG had 4 zero-sale days, 2 "empty" audits and an estimated ~181 lost units (~₹48k) — fix its replenishment rather than drop it. SUGAR-1KG is the weakest line (lowest margin ₹3,054, lowest units 509, 1 empty audit) — a candidate to drop or reprice; nothing new can be justified from these records (no candidate-product data exists).

**Q2 — Supplier terms & working capital.** No supplier/vendor/payables/terms data exists anywhere in the three schemas. Working capital can only be proxied by inventory at cost: average ₹57,087 in June, closing ₹62,067 on 28 June; no cash, receivables or payables records.

**Q3 — Complaints in June:** 26 (23 "charged twice", 3 "debited but the till said failed").

**Q4 — Profitability.** June revenue ₹1,243,937 (till lines = daily sales), COGS ₹1,107,731, gross margin ₹136,206 (10.9%); after write-offs at cost (₹15,269) ≈ ₹120,937. MDR was ₹0. Rent, wages and other overheads are not recorded, so net profit cannot be confirmed — at gross level, yes.

**Q5 — Empty shelf-audit rows in June:** 3 (SUGAR-1KG on 5 Jun; ATTA-WW-5KG on 12 and 26 Jun).

**Q6 — Products sold:** 11 (consistent across products, daily_sales and pos_lines).

**Q7 — Cashier productivity:** no_record. No cashier/staff/till-operator identifier exists in any table (pos_lines, pos_payments checked).

**Q8 — Elasticity of 5 kg atta:** no_record. ATTA-WW-5KG sold at a single price (₹265.00) for the entire May 4 – Jun 28 period in both products and pos_lines; no price change exists to measure a demand response.
